pages.title: Base Stats
pages.text:
The Sea Doll is fully adapted to underwater environments, ideal for exploring ocean monuments and deep waters.

• HP: 120
• Regen IV + Resistance II + Fire Resistance
• Fully adapted underwater (free movement, water pathfinding)

pages.title: Aura & Abilities
pages.text:
Combat
• Melee/Archer mode auto-fires a laser (magic damage 20, 1.5s charge-up, 1s cooldown)

Aura
• Sea-mob pacify: sea mobs within 16 blocks cannot build aggro on the doll or its owner
• The owner gains Water Breathing while nearby (16-block range), underwater mining speed is not reduced, and Mining Fatigue is removed

pages.title: Fishing Mode
pages.text:
In Fishing mode the Sea Doll fishes automatically, hooks twice as fast, and yields double on reeling in.

Enchantments on the fishing rod (such as Luck of the Sea and Lure) are recognized and applied correctly by the Sea Doll.

pages.title: Crafting Recipe
pages.text:
Surround the center with 8 kelp to craft the Sea Doll Egg.

Name the egg on an anvil, then right-click the ground while holding it to summon the doll.
